ある休日、日用品の買い物に出ていた時のことだ。\nドロテアから、スマートデバイス: One holiday while I was out buying daily necessities, a message from Dorothea came through on my smart device.

よかったら、直接会って話すか？: If you like, should we meet up and talk in person?
えっ、いいんですか……？\nそんな拘束するつもりは……: Huh, is that alright...? I didn't mean to tie up your time...
どうせ今日たいした用事もなかったし、気にしなくていいよ。\n１時間後にカフェでど: I don't really have anything major planned today anyway, so don't worry about it. How about meeting at a cafe in an hour?

じゃあ、カフェの場所だけど――: Alright, as for where the cafe is—

わざわざお時間を割いていただき、ありがとうございます。: Thank you very much for taking time out of your day to meet with me.
そんな改まらなくていいよ。\nむしろ頼ってくれて嬉しい。: There's no need to be so formal. I'm actually happy you came to me.

落ち着きなく見えますか……お恥ずかしい限りです。: Do I seem restless...? How embarrassing.

はい。でも一応リュシーにはあなたと待ち合わせていることを、\n書き置きで告げてい: Yes. But I did leave a note for Lucy letting her know I was meeting with you. Though... I didn't give her any details.
もしかして、その相談ごとってリュシー達には話してないのか？: Did you not tell Lucy and the others about what you wanted to consult me about, then?
みんなの前で迷い、思い悩む頼りない姿を、\nあまり見せたくないので……: I don't really want to show them an unreliable side of me, wandering lost and troubled in front of everyone...
ですが、ひとりで悩んでいても答えは出ず……\nそこでチーム以外で信頼できる方の意: However, worrying about it alone didn't yield any answers... So I thought I would ask for the opinion of someone I could trust outside of my team.
（それで俺を頼ってくれたのか……なんだか、光栄だな）: (So that's why she relied on me... I feel kind of honored.)
で、相談内容ってのはなんだ？: So, what is it you want to consult me about?

そしていずれは、わたくしが家督を継ぐこととなります。\nそれ自体は良いのですが…: And eventually, I will succeed as head of the family. That in itself is fine, but...
恥ずかしながら今のわたくしには、\n家名を継ぐ者として――貴族として示すべき実績: Embarrassingly enough, the present me lacks any accomplishments to show for as someone who will inherit the family name—as a noble.
在学中になんとしても、家の名に恥じない\n実績を打ち立てないといけないのに……: Even though I must establish achievements during my time at school worthy of our family's name no matter what...
すでに所属校舎のユーロ・タワー屈指のパイロットじゃないか。\nそれって実績じゃな: But aren't you already one of the top pilots in Euro Tower, your school building? Isn't that an accomplishment in itself?
それだけでは足りません。数あるエピソードのひとつ……としては、\n悪くないのです: That alone is not enough. As a single episode among many... it's not bad, but...
なるほどな……それでどのようにその実績を作ればいいか、\n悩んでいるとか？: I see... So you're worrying about how you should build up those kinds of accomplishments?
そこで、あなたの意見を聞かせてほしいのです。: That's why I would like to hear your opinion.
少し、街歩きでもしないか？: Why don't we walk around town for a bit?
正直俺もいきなり言われたところで、『じゃあ、これがいい』って案は\n浮かばない。: Honestly, even if you ask me out of nowhere like this, I can't immediately come up with a "well, this would be good" idea.
ああ、だからお互い考えても何も浮かばないなら、\nいっそのこと『何も考えない』を: Yeah. So if neither of us can think of anything right now, I figure it's better to just try "not thinking about anything" for a bit.
考えすぎると視野が狭くなったり、凝り固まったりするだろ？\n気分転換を挟んでそう: If you overthink things, your vision gets narrow and your thinking gets stiff, right? Taking a break to change your mood helps reset that.
なるほど……それで街歩き……: I see... That's why you suggested walking around town...
確かにずっと思い詰めすぎて、少し袋小路に陥っていた気がします。\nそこからどう進: Indeed, I feel like I've been obsessing over this so much that I hit a dead end. Taking a step back rather than pushing forward from there makes a lot of sense.
そこから何か閃くものもありますでしょう。: Maybe an inspiration will strike us along the way.
そういうこった。じゃあ、さっそく店を出ようか。: Exactly. Alright, let's head out of the cafe then.
実はあまり……日常の買い物はほとんどリュシー達に任せているので。: Not really, to be honest... I usually leave daily shopping to Lucy and the others.
こちらのお店のお洋服、とても素敵です！\n見てください、どれも可愛い……！: The clothes in this store are lovely! Look, every single one is so cute...!
ふふっ、見ているだけで心が浮き立ちます。\nところであなたは――: Fufu, just looking at them lifts my spirits. By the way, do you—
いや、あまり来ないかな: Nah, I don't come here much.
こういうところによく来るんですか？: Do you come to places like this often?
そうなんですね。では今のわたくしは日々のあなたと、\n同じものを見ているんですね: I see. So right now, I'm looking at the same sights that you see every day...
では、わたくしと似ていますね。\n近い目線で物事を見れて嬉しいです。: In that case, we are quite alike. I'm glad I can see things from a perspective similar to yours.
ふふ、こういった服は普段着ることがないので、\nどうも『着た自分』というのが想像: Fufu, since I don't usually wear clothes like these, I really can't imagine "myself wearing them."
きっと似合うと思うよ。: I'm sure they'd look great on you.
そうでしょうか？ ふふ、殿方に言われると、\n少し照れてしまいますね。: Do you think so? Fufu, being told that by a gentleman makes me a little embarrassed.
でもそういうのって、いわゆる社交界っていうのか？\nパーティーとかで言われ慣れて: But aren't you used to hearing things like that at parties in social circles?
確かにパーティーで言われることは多いですが、\nそれとあなたからの言葉は全然別物: It's true that I hear it often at parties, but hearing it from you is a completely different matter...
あ、いえ、なんでもありません！\nつ、次の場所へ向かいましょう！: Ah, no, it's nothing! L-Let's move on to the next place!
お、おう？ ドロテアがそう言うなら、移動しようか。: O-Oh? If you say so, Dorothea, let's head over.
ここは……とても賑やかですね……！\nこんなにも色々な種類の機械が……全部ゲーム: This place is... so lively...! So many different kinds of machines... Are these all arcade games?
そうだよ。もしかしてここに来るのは初めて？: Yeah. Is this your first time coming to an arcade?

もしかしてゲーム自体したことないとか？: Have you never played games in general before?
いえ、カードやチェスのようなボードゲームは嗜みますよ。\nただこういった機械仕掛: No, I do enjoy card games and board games like chess. It's just that I've hardly ever touched these kinds of mechanical machines.
じゃあ、試しに何かプレイしてみようか。: Well then, why don't we try playing something?
これはパンチングマシーンだな。\n筐体についたパッドを思いっきり殴って、その強さ: This is a punching machine. You punch the pad on the machine as hard as you can to compete for strength.
とりあえずやってみよう。\nスマートデバイスから支払って――っと。: Let's give it a try. Pay with the smart device—and there we go.
意外といくな……さすがユーロ・タワー屈指のパイロット。: That's surprisingly high... As expected of one of Euro Tower's best pilots.
えへへ……鍛えてますので……: Ehehe... I do train, after all...
この機種の表示では女性の平均が５０～７５キロ、\n男性の平均が１２０～１８０キロ: According to the display on this machine, the average for women is 50 to 75 kg, and men's average is 120 to 180 kg, so that's a really great score.
ふふ、あなたもやってみませんか？\nどちらがより数値を出せるか、勝負してみたいで: Fufu, why don't you try as well? I'd love to have a match to see who can get a higher score.
それなら……わかった。俺も挑戦してみるよ。: In that case... alright. I'll take a shot at it too.
（意外と負けず嫌いなのかもな、ドロテアって。\nこれは男として、負けられないな）: (Dorothea might actually be pretty competitive. As a guy, I can't lose this.)
そんなことを思いながら、\nゲームをスタートさせ、全力でパンチを叩きこむ。: Thinking that, I started the game and threw a punch with all my strength.
す、すごい、２５０キロ！ 倍以上だなんて……！: A-Amazing, 250 kilograms! That's more than double...!
ははは、いいところ見せられてよかったよ。\n次のゲームに行くか？ あっちにはレー: Hahaha, I'm glad I could look good in front of you. Want to move on to the next game? They have racing games over there too.
その後、いくつかのゲームを軽く遊ぶうち、\n昼どきになったので食事にしようとゲー: After casually playing a few more games, lunchtime arrived, so we left the arcade to grab something to eat.
たくさんお店があって、目移りしますね。\nラーメンにハンバーガー、珍しいお食事が: There are so many shops, I don't know where to look. Ramen, hamburgers, so many unfamiliar dishes!
こういうのはやっぱり……？: Is eating out like this also...?
はい、普段の食事はリュシーが管理しているので、\nそもそも外食の機会というものが: Yes. Lucy manages my daily meals, so I rarely get the chance to eat out in the first place...
そっか……なら、このあたりで何か――: I see... Then let's grab something around here—
『３０分以内に牛丼１０杯を食べられたなら無料』か。\n１０杯はさすがに厳しい――: "Eat 10 beef bowls in 30 minutes and your meal is free," huh. 10 bowls would be pretty tough—
こういうの、以前から興味があったんです！\n挑戦とあらば、カークランド家の人間が: I've been interested in things like this for a long time! When presented with a challenge, a member of the Kirkland family cannot turn away!

これが、牛丼なんですね……なんて美味しそう！: So this is a beef bowl... It looks so delicious!
いけない、感動している場合ではありませんね。\n時間制限があるんでした！: Oh dear, now is not the time to be admiring it. There is a time limit!

うぅ、これほど厳しい結果になるとは、思いもよりませんでした。: Ugh, I never expected the result to be so brutal.
たったの３杯完食で終わってしまうだなんて……\n時間さえ、あればまだ頑張れました: To think I only managed to finish three bowls... If only I had more time, I could have kept going.
（並盛とはいえ、女の子で３杯はすごいと思うけどな）: (Though even if they were regular servings, three bowls for a girl is pretty impressive...)
（ただ、食べ方が上品というか、丁寧すぎたな……\n一口一口をあんな味わうように食: (Her manners were just way too refined and polite... Savoring every single bite like that was never going to work against the clock...)
でも美味しかったですし、楽しかったです。\n腹ごなしに、少しお散歩いたしませんか: Still, it was delicious and fun. Shall we take a walk to help digest our food?
それなら近くの公園へ行こう。: Let's go to the park nearby then.
ふう……今日はとても楽しかったです。\n見て、遊んで、食べて……どれもが新鮮でし: Phew... I had a wonderful time today. Sightseeing, playing games, eating... everything felt so fresh and new.
それはよかった。でも肝心の実績の作り方については……\n俺は何もいいアイデアは出: Glad to hear it. But as for the main issue—how to build up your accomplishments... I couldn't come up with any good ideas.
一応、あれこれ考えてはいたんだがな。\nドロテアはどうだ？: I was trying to brainstorm in the back of my mind though. How about you, Dorothea?
そうですね……端的にいえばわたくしも、\n気分転換を経たところで特に閃くアイデア: Well... simply put, even after changing my mood, I didn't have any sudden flashes of inspiration either.
ですが……こうして街で１日を過ごして、\n大切なことに気づけた気がします。: However... after spending a day in the city like this, I feel I've realized something important.
街で見かけた皆は、すごく平和そうに過ごしていました。\n仲間や友人達と何でもない: Everyone I saw in town seemed to be living so peacefully, sharing an ordinary day with their companions and friends.
もちろん、個々に内心で抱えたものもあるでしょう。\nまさしく今のわたくしのように: Of course, everyone must have their own internal struggles as well—just like me right now...
ですが、その悩む自由すら存在するこの日常を、\n皆平和に、そして幸せそうに謳歌し: Yet, everyone was peacefully and happily enjoying this daily life—a daily life where even the freedom to worry exists.
きっとそれを守ることこそが、曲がりなりにも貴族として生まれた\n者の務めなんだと: I believe that protecting this everyday peace is the duty of those born as nobles, however imperfect we may be.
ノブレス・オブリージュ、高貴なる者に伴う義務。\n貴族にとって大事なのは、実績と: Noblesse oblige—the obligation that accompanies nobility. What matters most to a noble isn't the concrete "form" of achievements.
皆の平和で幸せな時間を守ろうとする『心』。\n本当に必要なのはそれだと……わたく: It is the "heart" that strives to protect everyone's peaceful and happy times. That is what is truly necessary... or so I've realized.
こんな当然のことを、『貴族』であろうとして悩みすぎたがゆえに、\nいつの間にか頭: In my agonizing over trying to "be a noble," I somehow lost sight of something so natural and fundamental.
ドロテアの生まれ故郷って確かノヴァセレスってところだっけ……\n君の言う『皆』っ: Your hometown is Novaceres, right...? By "everyone," do you mean the people there?
……もちろん、彼らも含みますが、彼らだけを守ればいいという\nものではありません: ...Of course, they are included, but protecting them alone is not enough.
誰であろうが関係なく、『平和な日常を守る義務』を果たす意志こそが、\n真に恥じな: Regardless of who it is, having the will to fulfill the "duty to protect peaceful daily life" is what truly makes one a noble without shame... That is what I believe.
逆に言えばその意志さえあれば、仮に地位や名誉を失っても、\nきっとわたくし達は誇: Conversely, as long as we possess that will, even if we were to lose our position and honor, I am certain we could still remain proud "nobles."
そうか……ちなみにその平和な日常の中に、\nドロテア自身は含んでいるか？: I see... By the way, does that peaceful daily life include yourself as well, Dorothea?

だから、ちゃんと『平和な日常』の中に、\n自分自身も含んであげてほしいんだ。: So, I want you to properly include yourself inside that "peaceful daily life" too.
はい……しっかり、わたくし自身の日常も守っていこうと思います。: Yes... I will make sure to firmly protect my own daily life as well.
ああ、それでいい……って、ちょっと偉そうだったかな。: Yeah, that's it... Though, was I sounding a bit too full of myself?
いえ、むしろあなたはわたくし達にとっても\n『教導指揮官』なんですから、もっと偉: Not at all. After all, you are our Instructing Commander, so you are more than welcome to act authoritative.
それはちょっと恐縮しちゃうな。: Hearing that makes me feel a bit self-conscious.
ふふ、%usernameusernameuserna%さんらしいですね。\nそう: Fufu, that's so like you, %usernameusernameuserna%-san. It's that part of you—
ふふ、これより先は秘密です。\n今はまだ胸の内にしまっておきましょう。: Fufu, anything beyond that is a secret. Let us leave it tucked away in my heart for now.
こういうのは、ここぞというときに申し上げるから意味があるんですよ。\nなので、こ: Saying something like this only holds meaning when expressed at the right moment. So let us save this conversation for another time.
……はは、わかった。\nそのときを楽しみにしているよ。: ...Haha, alright. I'll look forward to that time.
